fullText.simplified:
第8章、一笔钱

    因为高尔不能工作了，家里很快没钱了。
    高尔急得想哭，他担心极了，也害怕极了。他经常爬到门后，听爸爸、妈妈和妹妹说话。他知道，他们一定过得不好。但是，他很少听到他们说话，好像这个家里有什么可怕的东西，让他们不敢也不想说话了。
    半个月过去了，高尔还是没有看到爸爸、妈妈和妹妹。但慢慢地，高尔听到他们开始说话了。虽然他们说话的声音很小，但高尔很高兴，他太想他们的声音了！
    有一天，高尔听到了一件让他特别吃惊的事——爸爸拿出了一笔钱。拿钱出来的时候，爸爸这样说：“旅游公司关门的时候，我留了一些钱，现在可以拿出来用了。”
    爸爸——他还有钱？这太让高尔吃惊了。七年前旅游公司关门的时候，爸爸说没有钱了，所以十六岁的高尔离开了学校。看来那时候的爸爸没有对家人说真话。虽然有一些难过，但高尔还是笑了。现在爸爸拿出的这笔钱，不但可以还钱给银行，还能让家里人生活一年，这让高尔开心了一些。
    但最让高尔担心的事情还是发生了，那就是没钱交学费以后，妹妹也离开了学校。
    妹妹不去上学了，她在一个法国饭店找了一个服务员的工作。每天上午十点，她出门上班，晚上十一点下班回来。高尔不敢想妹妹穿着服务员的衣服在饭店里工作的样子。高尔太伤心了，妹妹是像公主一样的女孩啊！她喜欢漂亮衣服，喜欢弹钢琴。她是要去音乐学校上学的公主啊，怎么能在饭店里做服务员呢？
fullText.traditional:
第8章、一筆錢

    因為高爾不能工作了，家裡很快沒錢了。
    高爾急得想哭，他擔心極了，也害怕極了。他經常爬到門後，聽爸爸、媽媽和妹妹說話。他知道，他們一定過得不好。但是，他很少聽到他們說話，好像這個家裡有什麼可怕的東西，讓他們不敢也不想說話了。
    半個月過去了，高爾還是沒有看到爸爸、媽媽和妹妹。但慢慢地，高爾聽到他們開始說話了。雖然他們說話的聲音很小，但高爾很高興，他太想他們的聲音了！
    有一天，高爾聽到了一件讓他特別吃驚的事——爸爸拿出了一筆錢。拿錢出來的時候，爸爸這樣說：“旅遊公司關門的時候，我留了一些錢，現在可以拿出來用了。”
    爸爸——他還有錢？這太讓高爾吃驚了。七年前旅遊公司關門的時候，爸爸說沒有錢了，所以十六歲的高爾離開了學校。看來那時候的爸爸沒有對家人說真話。雖然有一些難過，但高爾還是笑了。現在爸爸拿出的這筆錢，不但可以還錢給銀行，還能讓家里人生活一年，這讓高爾開心了一些。
    但最讓高爾擔心的事情還是發生了，那就是沒錢交學費以後，妹妹也離開了學校。
    妹妹不去上學了，她在一個法國飯店找了一個服務員的工作。每天上午十點，她出門上班，晚上十一點下班回來。高爾不敢想妹妹穿著服務員的衣服在飯店裡工作的樣子。高爾太傷心了，妹妹是像公主一樣的女孩啊！她喜歡漂亮衣服，喜歡彈鋼琴。她是要去音樂學校上學的公主啊，怎麼能在飯店裡做服務員呢？

sentences.simplified: 因为高尔不能工作了，家里很快没钱了。
sentences.traditional: 因為高爾不能工作了，家裡很快沒錢了。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi gāo ěr bù néng gōng zuò le jiā lǐ hěn kuài méi qián le
sentences.english: Because Gao Er couldn’t work anymore, the family would soon run out of money.

sentences.simplified: 高尔急得想哭，他担心极了，也害怕极了。
sentences.traditional: 高爾急得想哭，他擔心極了，也害怕極了。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr jí de xiǎng kū tā dān xīn jí le yě hài pà jí le
sentences.english: Gao Er was so anxious that he wanted to cry. He was extremely worried and extremely scared.

sentences.simplified: 他经常爬到门后，听爸爸、妈妈和妹妹说话。
sentences.traditional: 他經常爬到門後，聽爸爸、媽媽和妹妹說話。
sentences.pinyin: tā jīng cháng pá dào mén hòu tīng bà ba mā ma hé mèi mei shuō huà
sentences.english: He often crawled behind the door to listen to his father, mother, and little sister talk.

sentences.simplified: 他知道，他们一定过得不好。
sentences.traditional: 他知道，他們一定過得不好。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī dào tā men yí dìng guò de bù hǎo
sentences.english: He knew that they must not be doing well.

sentences.simplified: 但是，他很少听到他们说话，
sentences.traditional: 但是，他很少聽到他們說話，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì tā hěn shǎo tīng dào tā men shuō huà
sentences.english: However, he rarely heard them speak.

sentences.simplified: 好像这个家里有什么可怕的东西，让他们不敢也不想说话了。
sentences.traditional: 好像這個家裡有什麼可怕的東西，讓他們不敢也不想說話了。
sentences.pinyin: hǎo xiàng zhè ge jiā lǐ yǒu shén me kě pà de dōng xi ràng tā men bù gǎn yě bù xiǎng shuō huà le
sentences.english: It was as if there was something terrifying in the house that made them afraid and unwilling to speak.

sentences.simplified: 半个月过去了，高尔还是没有看到爸爸、妈妈和妹妹。
sentences.traditional: 半個月過去了，高爾還是沒有看到爸爸、媽媽和妹妹。
sentences.pinyin: bàn ge yuè guò qù le gāo ěr hái shi méi yǒu kàn dào bà ba mā ma hé mèi mei
sentences.english: Half a month had passed, and Gao Er still hadn’t seen his father, mother, and little sister.

sentences.simplified: 但慢慢地，高尔听到他们开始说话了。
sentences.traditional: 但慢慢地，高爾聽到他們開始說話了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn màn man de gāo ěr tīng dào tā men kāi shǐ shuō huà le
sentences.english: But slowly, Gao Er began to hear them talking.

sentences.simplified: 虽然他们说话的声音很小，但高尔很高兴，他太想他们的声音了！
sentences.traditional: 雖然他們說話的聲音很小，但高爾很高興，他太想他們的聲音了！
sentences.pinyin: suī rán tā men shuō huà de shēng yīn hěn xiǎo dàn gāo ěr hěn gāo xìng tā tài xiǎng tā men de shēng yīn le
sentences.english: Although their voices were very soft, Gao Er was very happy. He missed their voices so much!

sentences.simplified: 有一天，高尔听到了一件让他特别吃惊的事——爸爸拿出了一笔钱。
sentences.traditional: 有一天，高爾聽到了一件讓他特別吃驚的事——爸爸拿出了一筆錢。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yì tiān gāo ěr tīng dào le yí jiàn ràng tā tè bié chī jīng de shì bà ba ná chū le yì bǐ qián
sentences.english: One day, Gao Er heard something that particularly surprised him—his father took out a sum of money.

sentences.simplified: 拿钱出来的时候，爸爸这样说：
sentences.traditional: 拿錢出來的時候，爸爸這樣說：
sentences.pinyin: ná qián chu lai de shí hou bà ba zhè yàng shuō
sentences.english: When taking out the money, his father said, ..

sentences.simplified: “旅游公司关门的时候，我留了一些钱，现在可以拿出来用了。”
sentences.traditional: “旅遊公司關門的時候，我留了一些錢，現在可以拿出來用了。”
sentences.pinyin: lǚ yóu gōng sī guān mén de shí hou wǒ liú le yì xiē qián xiàn zài kě yǐ ná chu lai yòng le
sentences.english: .. “When the travel company closed, I set aside some money. We can take it out and use it now.”

sentences.simplified: 爸爸——他还有钱？这太让高尔吃惊了。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸——他還有錢？這太讓高爾吃驚了。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba tā hái yǒu qián zhè tài ràng gāo ěr chī jīng le
sentences.english: His father—he still had money? This surprised Gao Er greatly.

sentences.simplified: 七年前旅游公司关门的时候，爸爸说没有钱了，
sentences.traditional: 七年前旅遊公司關門的時候，爸爸說沒有錢了，
sentences.pinyin: qī nián qián lǚ yóu gōng sī guān mén de shí hou bà ba shuō méi yǒu qián le
sentences.english: When the travel agency closed down seven years ago, his father said there was no money left.

sentences.simplified: 所以十六岁的高尔离开了学校。
sentences.traditional: 所以十六歲的高爾離開了學校。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ shí liù suì de gāo ěr lí kāi le xué xiào
sentences.english: That was why sixteen-year-old Gao Er left school.

sentences.simplified: 看来那时候的爸爸没有对家人说真话。
sentences.traditional: 看來那時候的爸爸沒有對家人說真話。
sentences.pinyin: kàn lái nà shí hou de bà ba méi yǒu duì jiā rén shuō zhēn huà
sentences.english: It seemed that at that time, his father didn’t tell his family the truth.

sentences.simplified: 虽然有一些难过，但高尔还是笑了。
sentences.traditional: 雖然有一些難過，但高爾還是笑了。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán yǒu yì xiē nán guò dàn gāo ěr hái shi xiào le
sentences.english: Although he was a bit sad, Gao Er still smiled.

sentences.simplified: 现在爸爸拿出的这笔钱，不但可以还钱给银行，还能让家里人生活一年，
sentences.traditional: 現在爸爸拿出的這筆錢，不但可以還錢給銀行，還能讓家里人生活一年，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài bà ba ná chū de zhè bǐ qián bú dàn kě yǐ huán qián gěi yín háng hái néng ràng jiā lǐ rén shēng huó yì nián
sentences.english: The money that his father took out could not only repay the bank but also support the family for a year.

sentences.simplified: 这让高尔开心了一些。
sentences.traditional: 這讓高爾開心了一些。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ràng gāo ěr kāi xīn le yì xiē
sentences.english: This made Gao Er a little happier.

sentences.simplified: 但最让高尔担心的事情还是发生了，
sentences.traditional: 但最讓高爾擔心的事情還是發生了，
sentences.pinyin: dàn zuì ràng gāo ěr dān xīn de shì qing hái shi fā shēng le
sentences.english: But the thing that worried Gao Er the most still happened.

sentences.simplified: 那就是没钱交学费以后，妹妹也离开了学校。
sentences.traditional: 那就是沒錢交學費以後，妹妹也離開了學校。
sentences.pinyin: nà jiù shì méi qián jiāo xué fèi yǐ hòu mèi mei yě lí kāi le xué xiào
sentences.english: That is, after running out of money for tuition, his little sister also left school.

sentences.simplified: 妹妹不去上学了，她在一个法国饭店找了一个服务员的工作。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹不去上學了，她在一個法國飯店找了一個服務員的工作。
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei bú qù shàng xué le tā zài yí ge fǎ guó fàn diàn zhǎo le yí ge fú wù yuán de gōng zuò
sentences.english: His little sister was no longer going to school. She had found a job as a waitress at a French restaurant.

sentences.simplified: 每天上午十点，她出门上班，晚上十一点下班回来。
sentences.traditional: 每天上午十點，她出門上班，晚上十一點下班回來。
sentences.pinyin: měi tiān shàng wǔ shí diǎn tā chū mén shàng bān wǎn shang shí yī diǎn xià bān huí lái
sentences.english: Every day at ten o’clock in the morning, she would leave for work, and at eleven o’clock in the evening, she would come back.

sentences.simplified: 高尔不敢想妹妹穿着服务员的衣服在饭店里工作的样子。
sentences.traditional: 高爾不敢想妹妹穿著服務員的衣服在飯店裡工作的樣子。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr bù gǎn xiǎng mèi mei chuān zhe fú wù yuán de yī fu zài fàn diàn lǐ gōng zuò de yàng zi
sentences.english: Gao Er couldn’t bear to imagine his little sister dressed in a waitress uniform, working at a restaurant.

sentences.simplified: 高尔太伤心了，妹妹是像公主一样的女孩啊！
sentences.traditional: 高爾太傷心了，妹妹是像公主一樣的女孩啊！
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr tài shāng xīn le mèi mei shì xiàng gōng zhǔ yí yàng de nǚ hái a
sentences.english: Gao Er was so sad. His little sister was a girl who was like a princess!

sentences.simplified: 她喜欢漂亮衣服，喜欢弹钢琴。
sentences.traditional: 她喜歡漂亮衣服，喜歡彈鋼琴。
sentences.pinyin: tā xǐ huan piào liang yī fu xǐ huan tán gāng qín
sentences.english: She liked wearing pretty clothes and enjoyed playing the piano.

sentences.simplified: 她是要去音乐学校上学的公主啊，怎么能在饭店里做服务员呢？
sentences.traditional: 她是要去音樂學校上學的公主啊，怎麼能在飯店裡做服務員呢？
sentences.pinyin: tā shì yào qù yīn yuè xué xiào shàng xué de gōng zhǔ a zěn me néng zài fàn diàn lǐ zuò fú wù yuán ne
sentences.english: She was a princess who was supposed to go to music school. How could she be a waitress in a restaurant?

sentence_translations: Chapter 8: A Sum of Money
Because Gao Er couldn’t work anymore, the family would soon run out of money.
Gao Er was so anxious that he wanted to cry. He was extremely worried and extremely scared.
He often crawled behind the door to listen to his father, mother, and little sister talk.
He knew that they must not be doing well.
However, he rarely heard them speak.
It was as if there was something terrifying in the house that made them afraid and unwilling to speak.
Half a month had passed, and Gao Er still hadn’t seen his father, mother, and little sister.
But slowly, Gao Er began to hear them talking.
Although their voices were very soft, Gao Er was very happy. He missed their voices so much!
One day, Gao Er heard something that particularly surprised him—his father took out a sum of money.
When taking out the money, his father said, ..
.. “When the travel company closed, I set aside some money. We can take it out and use it now.”
His father—he still had money? This surprised Gao Er greatly.
When the travel agency closed down seven years ago, his father said there was no money left.
That was why sixteen-year-old Gao Er left school.
It seemed that at that time, his father didn’t tell his family the truth.
Although he was a bit sad, Gao Er still smiled.
The money that his father took out could not only repay the bank but also support the family for a year.
This made Gao Er a little happier.
But the thing that worried Gao Er the most still happened.
That is, after running out of money for tuition, his little sister also left school.
His little sister was no longer going to school. She had found a job as a waitress at a French restaurant.
Every day at ten o’clock in the morning, she would leave for work, and at eleven o’clock in the evening, she would come back.
Gao Er couldn’t bear to imagine his little sister dressed in a waitress uniform, working at a restaurant.
Gao Er was so sad. His little sister was a girl who was like a princess!
She liked wearing pretty clothes and enjoyed playing the piano.
She was a princess who was supposed to go to music school. How could she be a waitress in a restaurant?
